scope: we performed immunoprecipitation (IP) of THRB in THRB-FLAG HepG2 cells with anti-FLAG antibody, followed by mass-spectrometry to identify THRB-binding proteins
The clear lysates were incubated with 100 µL protein G dynabeads (Thermo Fisher 10003D) for 2 hours at 4´C. Pellets were washed 4 times with NP40 buffer.

For mass-spectrometry, the dynabeads samples were washed and resuspended in a Tris/ Urea buffer, reduced with dithiothreitol, alkylated with iodoacetamide and digested with trypsin at 37 ´C overnight.
subcellular_fraction: The nuclear fraction and supernatant fraction (800 µL) were collected, and 8 µg rabbit-anti-FLAG antibody (Sigma F7425), or about 8 µg rabbit control serum were added to incubate overnight at 4 ´C.
